_meta.note: All values parsed at runtime; no token literal is hardcoded in this script.

deadClasses.method: audit_ui.py style: global class = className literal token; module class = styles.X / styles['X']; G11 style: bare-word regex over tsx/ts corpus, module css only, collapsed/active/open exempt

auditStyle.note: raw scripts/audit_ui.py regex; misses className={`template ${\x} literal`} tokens

robust.note: same method, className {...} parsed with balanced braces and ${...} stripped

caveats: auditStyle false positives: className expression template literals are mis-split by scripts/audit_ui.py:29, e.g. .sidebar-premium (used at src/components/Sidebar.tsx:91), .mb-item and .tile-input-row.

robust false positives: class names passed as quoted strings inside JS expressions are invisible to className parsing, e.g. .mb-item-active (src/components/AppShell.tsx:323), .single-col/.three-col (src/components/formulas/FormulaCard.tsx:231-234), .active/.closed dynamic state.

G11 false negatives: bare-word matching also fires on same-named global classes and ordinary identifiers, e.g. module .sidebar-header vs global .sidebar-header (src/app/globals.css:180), .warning, .toggle, .overlay, .webhookUrl.

misc.contrastScope: foreground candidates only (role text/border/accent/status); surface tokens are the backgrounds being compared against

sanity.claim: --text-secondary (lowest-contrast text token) resolves to alpha 0.62 and passes 4.5:1; scripts/contrast.py:24 still asserts 0.18 and reports 1.67
